larger_land_option.limitation: This rejects local enlargement under the full-width J2 pad strip, not every remote location. A relocated larger via would need materially more routing and a complete donor/return screen.

parallel_via_option.recommendation: Not required to correct these four off-center entries. A parallel ordinary via is a distinct load-current/fabrication design choice, not a geometric necessity or proven current rating. No new barrel is proposed without a validated all-layer position and explicit current-stackup criterion.

manufacturer_context.finding: VOS is output-voltage sensing/control, not the load-current output. TI calls for a short dedicated connection to the output capacitor, away from the VOUT power route and SW, with common AGND/PGND/thermal ground. Existing branch at 51a22cd5 taps the L1-to-C24 power route upstream of C24; this existing topology is preserved, and regulator-layout signoff remains open.

U9 pin 3 VIN1 is the load-supply input, while pin 5 MODE is a logic/configuration input. Thus a33d9038 transfers the downstream load branch; 51a22cd5 only serves the U5 VOS branch. Existing 0.127 mm necks at U9 are unchanged and are not certified by this review.

no_ampacity_claim: Annular area, full land coverage, trace widths and device labels do not establish allowable current, plating quality, temperature rise or assembled-board power capability.
verification_scope: Read-only native geometric checks; no board save, zone refill, DRC, router, GitHub write or user-computer access.
